strategies.name: Common Goal (collaborative)
strategies.description: Agents share one objective and pass results forward; every agent in a level runs and its result is merged. No contention or arbitration.
strategies.when_to_use: Sequential or independent work where each agent contributes a distinct piece and outputs are combined at the end. This is the default.

strategies.name: Bidding
strategies.description: Agents in a level bid for a contested resource by returning a score; the highest bidder commits (acts for real) and the losers are skipped.
strategies.when_to_use: Several agents in the same level want the same scarce resource (e.g. a single free ICU bed) and only one should act.

strategies.name: Competing
strategies.description: Agents independently produce candidate solutions; the best-scoring candidate is selected and the rest are discarded before synthesis.
strategies.when_to_use: Multiple valid approaches to the same goal exist and only the single best outcome should be kept.

strategies.name: Independent (parallel, no merge contention)
strategies.description: Agents in a level run fully in parallel with no coordination; identical to common_goal today but reserved for strategies that must never arbitrate.
strategies.when_to_use: Agents in a level act on disjoint resources and never contend.
